name: monitor-mikrotik-root
description: Monitor read-only de desconexões PPPoE no MikroTik CCR

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server --no-fund --no-audit && npm install --prefix web --no-fund --no-audit
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
